File surface: plugin-audit comment routes beside the existing unreact door (two new doors and their census rows), the resolution stamp's attribution, the console's comment wiring in plugin-detail and app-shell `RecordDetailView.tsx` (comment handlers only), a new affordance row, tests, docs, changeset.
Container & model: `M`, card thread, `model: opus`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: yes (widening): two new REST routes and a new affordance row.
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise (thread, file `build-seat1/36186-36191/premise-read.md` in the project folder): holds.
Scope, the seat's reading:
- #36186, door A: `PUT /api/v1/comments/:id/resolution` takes only `{resolved}`; it admits a caller who can read the comment as themselves (ruling 7063285032: anyone who can see the record, which includes any external member who can read it), refuses a reply with 400, writes only `is_resolved` through a system write, and stamps `resolved_by` as the caller. The `owner_only_writes` floor, `sys_comment_moderation` and the data route's resolve branch are unchanged; no `sys_comment` update twin (comment text stays author-only, ruling 7069889899). The console's ✓ always calls door A; the explain probe stays for editing others' comments only.
- #36191, door B: `DELETE /api/v1/comments/:id` on the shared kit `own-row-delete-routes.ts`, owner column `author_id`. Administrators keep the data route.
- Deleting a top-level comment that has replies: door B refuses it (409, `DELETE_RESTRICTED`) and the console offers no Delete there (Edit stays). The seat reads this as following the ruling, not a new choice: 「删不了别人的」 rules out cascading the replies away, and today's `set_null` would rewrite other members' reply rows through a system write. Administrators are unchanged. Stated in the PR's 维护者速读.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: folded: same epic, same plugin, same ruling, same rig tests; overlap only with #36136 in another region of `RecordDetailView.tsx`. `overlap-check.mjs` before each push. `check-governed-merges --test` expected 0 of 13 governed; contract L2 at the face the final paths decide; L1 at L1-c. The PR carries `Fixes #36186` and `Fixes #36191`.
